d: In this episode of ' Select Conversations with Tisca Chopra' Jaideep Ahlawat gets candid with Tisca Chopra as he opens up about being an introvert in Bollywood, networking at industry parties, romantic films, dancing, and why he wants to challenge himself with roles people would never expect him to do.F rom talking about Karan Johar films to praising Hrithik Roshan and Govinda’s dancing skills, this conversation is packed with honesty, humor, and insight.
